title: Noise-Space Reward Alignment for Few-Step Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-step generative models produce high-quality samples in one or a few evaluations. However, steering them toward desired properties remains difficult, especially when only black-box reward evaluations are available. While one could apply approaches developed for iterative diffusion and flow-based models, such as direct RL fine-tuning or test-time scaling, we find that neither transfers well to the few-step regime: direct fine-tuning suffers from severe reward over-optimization, and test-time scaling sacrifices the efficiency advantage of few-step generation. We propose Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which explicitly targets the alignment problem for few-step generative models. The key idea is to learn an amortized flow policy over the initial noise space of the generator. translated_title: 面向少步生成模型的噪声空间奖励对齐
translated_abstract: 少步生成模型能够在一至数次评估中生成高质量样本。然而，将这些模型引导至期望的属性仍然十分困难，尤其是在仅有黑盒奖励评估可用的情况下。虽然可以将为迭代式扩散模型和基于流的模型开发的方法（如直接强化学习微调或测试时扩展）应用于此，但我们发现这两种方法都不能很好地迁移到少步场景：直接微调存在严重的奖励过优化问题，而测试时扩展则牺牲了少步生成的效率优势。我们提出噪声策略优化，明确针对少步生成模型的奖励对齐问题。其核心思想是在生成器的初始噪声空间上学习一个摊销流策略。训练得到的策略将高斯噪声传输至一个偏向奖励的噪声分布，该分布经过冻结生成器的前推映射后恰好对应奖励对齐的样本分布。
tldr: 提出噪声策略优化（NPO），通过在生成器初始噪声空间上学习摊销流策略、将噪声分布向奖励倾斜，从而在保持少步生成效率优势的同时解决少步生成模型的奖励对齐问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which learns an amortized flow policy over the generator's initial noise space to transport Gaussian noise toward a reward-tilted distribution, enabling reward alignment for few-step generative models while preserving their efficiency advantage.
